title: Degradation attribution canvas and structured failure tagging
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description: Goal: Build an interactive degradation attribution canvas that surfaces why requests are failing or degrading QoS and attach a standardized set of structured failure tags (timeout, overload, model_reject, kv_cache_miss, invalid_input, http_5xx, grpc_14, resource_oom). This ticket covers schema design for structured failure tags, tracehook enrichment, sampling rules, and a Grafana/Console dashboard composed of small multiples: route-level SLO exposure, top contributing failure tag list, causal waterfall (service -> model -> infra), and an exploratory drilldown for traces and logs.
acceptance_criteria: Define and document a stable tag schema with canonical keys and severity levels
Tracehooks inject failure_tag and failure_reason fields into spans for all exit points
A dashboard (Console + Grafana link) with panels for top failure tags, per-route SLO exposure, and a causal waterfall is deployed to staging
Sampling policy adjusts higher sampling for traces containing high-severity tags and propagates sample decisions to downstream services
Playbook entries that map tags to standard remediation steps and oncall runbooks are added to Confluence
comments: 2026-02-15 - Sofia Ramirez: Kickoff — capture requirements from oncall, SRE, and platform. Primary ask: quickly identify whether an increase in 5xxs is model-related vs infra overload.

2026-02-18 - Arjun Patel: Prototype failure_tag schema and posted to docs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Structured+Failure+Tags (doc draft 0.1). Key fields: tag.key, tag.category, tag.severity, tag.origin, tag.code.
2026-02-22 - Eng Lead (review): Suggested adding 'sample_hint' and 'reroute_suggestion' metadata to tags for automated remediation later.

2026-02-26 - Arjun Patel: Spike results — added tracehook proof-of-concept that annotates spans at RPC exits and model runtime blocks. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8291
2026-03-02 - QA: Found that KV cache misses are over-tagged due to noisy instrumentation; added filter to only tag when latency delta > 20ms.
2026-03-05 - PM feedback (Maya Chen): Dashboard needs per-customer SLO exposure and a quick link to recent deploys; added as follow-up subtask.
notes: Design decision: use both categorical tag (timeout/overload/model_reject/http_5xx/grpc_code) and numeric severity (0-5) so dashboards can sort by impact.
We will reuse existing tracehook registration mechanism; changes are additive and have a gated rollout (feature flag failure-tagging).
Retention implication: tagged traces will be sampled at higher rate; coordinate with infra for storage budget in staging before prod rollout.
